valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 17 Nov 2026. (1) Business: renewable power generation (wind 84 MW, solar, hydro in Sri Lanka; solar in Uganda and Pakistan via subsidiaries and joint ventures) sold under long-term contracts to the CEB/NSO and UETCL, now adding grid battery storage (BESS) under 15-year contracts; engineering (EPC) and electric two-wheelers are small. One sector beta. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) couldn't be opened from this run; stand-in as used for Vidullanka: his global Green & Renewable Energy unlevered, cash-corrected beta 0.57 (January 2026, web-search extract). (3) Relevered with net debt Rs 24.89bn (30 Sep 2026) / market value Rs 54.22bn (1,355.4mn shares at Rs 40.00, 30 Sep 2026) = 0.46 and 25% tax: 0.57 x (1 + 0.75 x 0.46) = 0.77. (4) Local 5-year betas: none found by web search (fewer than 3 sources, so step 4 can't be completed). (5) Higher of steps 3 and 4: 0.77. (6) Within 0.3-2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file and three local 5-year betas. No extra premium for Uganda or Pakistan. 18 Nov 2026 (/redo full): Damodaran's site was blocked from this run again (HTTP 403) and a web search found no local 5-year beta for WIND.N0000; stand-in kept. Relevered at Rs 38.00 (CSE close 18 Nov 2026): net debt 24.89 / market value 51.51bn = 0.48, 0.57 x (1 + 0.75 x 0.48) = 0.78.

valuationInputs.name: WACC
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (18 Nov 2026): cost of debt 8.65% (interest paid 1.010 ÷ average borrowings and leases 11.67, FY2026), tax 12.3% (FY2026 effective), debt weight 32.6% (net debt Rs 24.89bn at Sep 2026, market cap Rs 51.51bn at Rs 38.00).

valuationInputs.value: Assumed 0% / 3% / 6%; supported 6.8% (reinvestment rate 83.9% × return on capital 8.2%, FY2026). All within 2 pts. Growth from the Rs 71bn project pipeline is valued separately (projects at cost), not through these rates.

openQuestions: Battery storage: are all 13 sites running by December 2026, and what do they earn (tariff not disclosed)? First revenue from October 2026.
Finance costs on Rs 28bn of borrowings: how much is capitalised during construction, and do new plants' earnings cover it?
Older wind farms (2010-2014): exact contract end dates and repowering plans and cost.
Rividhanavi 100 MW: construction progress, cost against US$133mn, tariff, commissioning (August 2027).
Curtailment compensation (Rs 194mn lost in H1 FY2027): timing of payment.
Project advances (Rs 10.9bn): confirm they move into plant as projects finish.
Shareholders: did the Tundra funds keep selling (Shikari Global left the top 20 by September 2026)?
Beta: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file and local 5-year betas.

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add WIND.N0000). First analysis. Research record built from the two downloaded reports (FY2025 and FY2026 full figures with reinvestment figures, FY2022-FY2024 from the five-year summary, H1 FY2027). Beta 0.77 (provisional; Damodaran global renewable-energy stand-in from web search, no local 5-year betas found) gives cost of equity 16.2% and WACC 13.5%. Methods: whole-company DCF plus projects and JVs 9.57, P/E 6.34, justified P/B 7.15, residual income 10.84, dividends 4.24. Business tests 3 of 4 (ROE fails at 6-8%): category 2, watch list. Price Rs 40.00 is the 30 Sep 2026 close from the interim report (the CSE couldn't be reached from this run). Not found: wind contract expiry dates, BESS and Rividhanavi tariffs, dividends before FY2025, FY2022 opening equity, R&D (not disclosed). Fair value Rs 7.65, buy Rs 6.50, strong buy Rs 5.75.

Research record rebuilt from the two downloaded reports: figures re-checked against the statements (no corrections needed); added the wind farms' commissioning dates and 20-year contract terms, company gearing and public holding. Analysis brought up to the current format: new management (plans, investment, promises vs delivery) and shareholders (top 20 vs March 2026) sections, and modelInputs so P/E, P/B, residual income and dividends come from scripts/valuation.py. Beta 0.78 (relevered at the new price; Damodaran's site blocked and no local 5-year betas found) gives cost of equity 16.3%, WACC 13.5%. Residual income falls from 10.84 to 5.21 because the shared calculator keeps the negative excess return after year 10. Methods: DCF plus projects and JVs 9.58, P/E 6.29, P/B 7.10, residual income 5.21, dividends 4.38. Business tests unchanged at 3 of 4 (ROE fails): category 2, watch list. Not found: exact wind contract end dates, BESS and Rividhanavi tariffs, local betas. Fair value Rs 7.65 → 6.51, buy Rs 6.50 → 5.54, strong buy Rs 5.75 → 4.88.
